purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S3-27, S3-11, S3-13, S3-15, S3-14, S3-16. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, A48 launch order). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES (this plan declares no gates); it stops automatically only at the launch budget / C10 cap. Every stop rule below is applied manually: the main session reads the state-only results/campaigns/<plan>.json (full record sealed under results/sealed/campaigns) and decides.
stop_rules: Register step 3, only after S3-12 showed IGZO.TOKYO ACTIVE in regions 1 and 2 (F gate): S3-27 c10_s3_27_6p3 (native profiling check of S3-12: Q_f +1e12, MUN x0.6; 2000 s; missing, timed out or unevaluable -> H-F D3/D4/D5 UNKNOWN), S3-11 c10_s3_11_2p0 (1600 s), S3-13 c10_s3_13_13p2 (3100 s); then the GAMMA0 +0.30 entries (A48 (c): registered later-order entries of step 3, no registered prediction, not H-F inputs) in the order of the -0.31 triple: S3-15 c10_s3_15_6p3 (2000 s), S3-14 c10_s3_14_2p0 (1600 s), S3-16 c10_s3_16_13p2 (3100 s).

State-only (A41 (e) inventory rule): each run is appended to config/sealed_runs.json as soon as its RUN_INDEX STARTED row exists; console and results/campaigns/<plan>.json carry state only; the full record is sealed under results/sealed/campaigns. No current, metric or deckbuild.out line of these runs is read before the register-order scoring (frozen H-F v4 for S3-10..13 and S3-27), except the A48 (b) activation read of S3-12 by the F gate (REGIONAL MOBILITY MODEL SUMMARY block only).

Every launch counts; a failed or timed-out launch is recorded invalid and kept; no repeat, no --retry, no repair in this stage (the PA-19 v3 pool of 6 stays reserved); the affected verdicts are UNRESOLVED / UNKNOWN as frozen in H-F v4.

No S3 branch is adopted from these plans: the adoption decision (profile_shared.py adopt, CAMPAIGN_DESIGN S3 rule) is a 0-launch step after the register-order scoring; contacts S3-17..S3-23 only if D4 fires, at register step 10; BQP/Boltzmann S3-24..26 after S5 (PA-10, cut list K2-K4).
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and C10 cap, refuses runnable=false plans and applies the state-only surface (scripts/campaign_sealed.py); this plan declares no gates
register_amendment: A48 (2026-10-15; stage F = S3 steps 3-5: PA-8 activation rule and fallback form, S3-14..16 ruling and order, tail plan, route plans, F gate; no Codex review, D-63): invoke only after A48 and its decision row are logged, with the go for THIS launch (Claude under D-59), immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_f.py has exited 0 naming this plan
launch_command: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml"; <project venv python> scripts/run_campaign.py config/campaign_C10_S3b_igzo.json   (PowerShell, package root, immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_f.py exited 0 naming this plan; no --retry; IWO_ATLAS_VIEWERS unset)
